author: RKE2 Toolbox CVE triage (govulncheck reachability analysis)

statements.impact_statement: The golang.org/x/net/html package is NOT compiled into this binary. Reproduced build graph (x/net v0.52.0, matching the shipped binary) `go list -deps` shows http2/idna/httpguts but no x/net/html; `go mod why golang.org/x/net/html` resolves only through the onsi/gomega test matchers (test-only). Vulnerable code not present.

The golang.org/x/net/html parser is linked but RKE2 components never parse attacker-supplied HTML; Parse/ParseFragment are not invoked on untrusted input in any default execution path. Verified with govulncheck -mode=binary against the v1.36.2-rc3 binaries.

The golang.org/x/crypto/ssh, ssh/agent and ssh/knownhosts packages are NOT compiled into this binary. The rancher build graph was reproduced exactly (clone at the shipped commit + Dockerfile go mod edit -replace directives + go mod tidy), yielding golang.org/x/crypto v0.49.0 — identical to the shipped binary's `go version -m`. `go list -deps ./cmd/<daemon>` shows only non-ssh x/crypto packages (cryptobyte, hkdf, chacha20poly1305, nacl/secretbox, salsa20); `go mod why golang.org/x/crypto/ssh` reports "main module does not need package". Vulnerable code not present.

The golang.org/x/crypto/ssh code is linked transitively via Kubernetes/cloud-provider dependencies but RKE2 components do not operate an SSH server, SSH agent, or knownhosts verification against untrusted input in the default configuration. The vulnerable symbols are not reachable from any attacker-controlled execution path. Verified with govulncheck -mode=binary against the v1.36.2-rc3 binaries.
